entities.name: Kinscaer
entities.description: Largest kithkin doun in Shadowmoor, an armed fortress.

entities.name: Gaddock Teeg
entities.description: Cenn who died under unknown circumstances.

entities.name: Donal Alloway
entities.description: Became cenn of Kinscaer; killed by Ashling.

entities.name: Oona
entities.description: Fae Queen who offered Tarcha help, then killed the kithkin.

entities.name: Rhys
entities.description: Arrived to find the doun dead.

entities.name: Mindweft
entities.description: Kithkin collective power exploited by Oona.

events.summary: Ashling attacks Kinscaer; Alloway and Tarcha try to force her away, and Ashling kills Alloway.
events.quote: After Ashling killed Alloway, Tarcha used her protective magic to teleport her to the edge of the world.

events.summary: Oona offers Tarcha help in exchange for Kinscaer supporting her against the Destroyer; Tarcha agrees.
Rhys finds Kinscaer's population strangled by Oona's vines.
events.quote: the whole doun's population was dead, strangled by Oona's vines

events.summary: Kinscaer is repopulated by kithkin from other douns after Oona's defeat.
events.quote: Kinscaer was repopulated by kithkin from other douns

relations.note: Killed all kithkin of the doun (target is the place)
relations.quote: The Fae Queen killed all the kithkin to exploit the power of their mindweft
